start: A pull request is opened, or someone presses 'Run workflow' on CI

steps.action: The pull_request or workflow_dispatch event starts job 'check'
user_sees: The same steps as a push, on the pull request's code
must_not: A pull request merged with no 'check' run
A different, shorter list of steps for a pull request

start: A push that adds a new silent catch, a new bare scroll check, or pushes a v* tag

steps.action: Push a commit with one more silent catch than the baseline
user_sees: Step 'Silent-catch ratchet' red; job 'check' red
must_not: The baseline count raised by the run so the push passes

steps.action: Push a phone-test file with a bare check on a page listed in scrollable-screens.yaml
user_sees: Step 'Phone-test scroll lint' red
must_not: The new bare check accepted because the old count still fits

steps.action: Push a v* tag
user_sees: No 'CI' run for the tag (release-apk.yml runs the checks)
must_not: Two different gates for one tag

tests.checks: s2 see (data only): bare checks on a scrolling page are found (lines 52-58). The baseline count (s2 not), the silent-catch ratchet (s1) and the tag rule (s3) are not tested

start: A push where a warn-only check finds a problem

steps.action: 'iPhone parity gate', 'Phone flows to check' and 'Expo doctor (mobile, warn only)' run with continue-on-error
user_sees: '::warning::expo-doctor: N check(s) failed (warn only, ...)' on the run page
Job 'check' still green
must_not: A warn-only step turning the whole job red
A warn-only failure hidden with no warning line

steps.action: Remove continue-on-error from 'iPhone parity gate' when iPhone work starts
user_sees: The parity gap now turns the job red
must_not: The switch left on warn after iPhone work restarts
